title: Suicide stand-down in the drone program

tellings.quote: They were calling me up and they're like, "Yo, we had a suicide standown."

plain: In 2013, according to a guest named Dylan Borland, the US Air Force's drone program called a suicide stand-down, a pause in normal work after suicides among its people. Borland says people from the program called him and told him, "Yo, we had a suicide standown." He tells it as something those callers passed on to him, as a sign of the strain inside the program.
